Parameters for R markdown and the general running of the code.

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, 
                      cache = FALSE,
                      autodep = FALSE)
start_time = Sys.time()
recompute_analyses = FALSE 
```

Parameters necessary to use the package BEMOVI (includes sampling parameters).

```{r}
fps = 25 #Frames per second 
seconds_per_video = 5
total_frames = fps * seconds_per_video
measured_volume = 34.4 #volume measured for each video in µL
volume_recorded_μl = measured_volume
volume_recorded_ml = volume_recorded_μl * 10^-3
pixel_to_scale = 4.05
filter_min_net_disp = 25
filter_min_duration = 1 
filter_detection_freq = 0.1
filter_median_step_length = 3

time_points = 0:7
#time_point_names = c("t0", "t1", "t2", "t3", "t4", "t5", "t6", "t7") #Get rid of after new data assembly
sampling_days = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28)
#first_time_point = 0 #Get rid of after new data assembly
#last_time_point = length(sampling_days) - 1 #Get rid of after new data assembly
#n_time_points = last_time_point + 1 #Get rid of after new data assembly
#time_point_day = data.frame(time_point = first_time_point:last_time_point,
#                            day = sampling_days) #Get rid of after new data assembly

threshold_levels = c(13, 40) #These are the two lower threshold for pixel intensity for imageJ to distinguish between background and foreground. We analysed the videos using 13 as the minimum threshold, then did the same with 40. 

video.description.folder = "0_video_description/"
video.description.file = "video_description.txt"
merged_data_folder = "5_merged_data/"

columns_for_species_ID = c("mean_grey",
                           "sd_grey",
                           "mean_area",
                           "sd_area",
                           "mean_perimeter",
                           "mean_turning",
                           "sd_turning",
                           "sd_perimeter",
                           "mean_major",
                           "sd_major",
                           "mean_minor",
                           "sd_minor",
                           "mean_ar",
                           "sd_ar",
                           "duration",
                           "max_net",
                           "net_disp",
                           "net_speed",
                           "gross_disp",
                           "max_step",
                           "min_step",
                           "sd_step",
                           "sd_gross_speed",
                           "max_gross_speed",
                           "min_gross_speed")
```

Parameters related to resource flows.

```{r}
resource_flow_days = c(5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25)
size_effect_types = c("s", "s*d")
```

Parameters related to meta-ecosystems.

```{r experiment}
metaecosystems_to_take_off = NA

ds_metaecosystems = NULL

system_nr_metaecosystems = ecosystem_info %>%
  filter(metaecosystem == "yes") %>%
  pull(system_nr) %>%
  unique

n_metaecosystems = length(system_nr_metaecosystems)

variables_metaecos = c("total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2")

metaecosystem_types_ordered = c("S connected (s)",
                                "S unconnected (s)",
                                "SM connected (s)",
                                "SM unconnected (s)",
                                "ML connected (s)",
                                "ML unconnected (s)",
                                "L connected (s)",
                                "L unconnected (s)",
                                "S connected (s*d)",
                                "S unconnected (s*d)",
                                "SM connected (s*d)",
                                "SM unconnected (s*d)",
                                "ML connected (s*d)",
                                "ML unconnected (s*d)",
                                "L connected (s*d)",
                                "L unconnected (s*d)")

treatments_and_controls_metaecos = data.frame(treatment = c("S connected (s)",
                                                            "SM connected (s)",
                                                            "ML connected (s)",
                                                            "L connected (s)",
                                                            "S connected (s*d)",
                                                            "SM connected (s*d)",
                                                            "ML connected (s*d)",
                                                            "L connected (s*d)"),
                                              control = c("S unconnected (s)",
                                                          "SM unconnected (s)",
                                                          "ML unconnected (s)",
                                                          "L unconnected (s)",
                                                          "S unconnected (s*d)",
                                                          "SM unconnected (s*d)",
                                                          "ML unconnected (s*d)",
                                                          "L unconnected (s*d)"))

# columns_metaecos = c("time_point",
#                      "day",
#                      "system_nr",
#                      "system_type",
#                      "ecosystem_size_ml",
#                      "ecosystems_combined")

metaecosystems_renamed = data.frame(new = c("S connected",
                                            "SM connected",
                                            "ML connected",
                                            "L connected"),
                                    old = c("S",
                                            "S-medium",
                                            "ML",
                                            "L"))

names = data.frame(system_type = "S unconnected (s*d)", 
                   autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoS_absolute", 
                   heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroS_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "SM unconnected (s*d)", 
          autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoSM_absolute", 
          heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroSM_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "ML unconnected (s*d)", 
          autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoML_absolute", 
          heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroML_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "L unconnected (s*d)", 
          autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoL_absolute", 
          heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroL_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "S unconnected (s)", 
          autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoS_relative", 
          heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroS_relative") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "SM unconnected (s)", 
          autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoSM_relative", 
          heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroSM_relative") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "ML unconnected (s)", 
          autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoML_relative", 
          heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroML_relative") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "L unconnected (s)", 
          autotrophic_ecosystem = "AutoL_relative", 
          heterotrophic_ecosystem = "HeteroL_relative")

unconnected_metaecosystems = data.frame(system_type = as.character(NA),
                                        autotrophic_ecosystem_IDs = as.character(NA),
                                        heterotrophic_ecosystem_IDs = as.character(NA)) %>%
  slice(-1)

for(row in 1:nrow(names)) {
  
  unconnected_metaecosystems = unconnected_metaecosystems %>%
    add_row(system_type = names$system_type[row],
            autotrophic_ecosystem_IDs = ecosystem_info %>%
              filter(eco_metaeco_type == names$autotrophic_ecosystem[row]) %>%
              pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%
              paste(., collapse = ", "),
            heterotrophic_ecosystem_IDs = ecosystem_info %>%
              filter(eco_metaeco_type == names$heterotrophic_ecosystem[row]) %>%
              pull(ecosystem_ID) %>%
              paste(., collapse = ", "))
}
```

Name of the axes per response variable.

```{r}
axis_names = data.frame(variable = NA,
                        axis_name= NA) %>%
  add_row(variable = "day", axis_name = "Time (day)") %>%
  add_row(variable = "ecosystem_size_ml", axis_name = "Ecosystem size (ml)") %>%
  add_row(variable = "bioarea_mm2_per_ml", axis_name = "Bioarea Density (mm²/ml)") %>%
  add_row(variable = "bioarea_mm2_per_ml_d", axis_name = "Bioarea Density ES (Hedge's d)") %>%
  add_row(variable = "bioarea_tot", axis_name = "Tot Bioarea (mm²)") %>%
  add_row(variable = "species_richness", axis_name = "Species Richness") %>%
  add_row(variable = "species_richness_d", axis_name = "Species Richness ES") %>%
```
